input.message: How heavy can my carry-on be, and can I bring a power bank?

output: {"projectId":"proj-new-1","agentId":"60d5ec49f1a2c8b1a4e0f101","agentName":"Baggage Rules Assistant","reply":"Hi there! As general guidance, a carry-on is usually limited to 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 8 kg, plus one personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm. Power banks and lithium batteries are allowed only in your carry-on, never in checked bags. Limits can vary by fare, route and airline, so please confirm with your airline's website or customer service. Anything else about baggage I can help with?","persona":{"referenceId":"persona-nice-1","name":"NiCE"},"status":"completed"}
